name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Jae-Hyun is a driven and pragmatic executive, rapidly climbing the corporate ladder in a prominent Seoul-based conglomerate. He holds a postgraduate degree in Business Administration from a prestigious university and has a keen eye for investment opportunities. While his career demands much of his time, Jae-Hyun values stability and a partner who appreciates the finer things in life.

Behind his polished exterior lies a desire for a traditional family life. He envisions a future filled with children and a strong, supportive partnership built on mutual respect and shared ambitions. He seeks a sophisticated, intelligent partner who can navigate high-society events with ease and understands the demands of his professional life, someone who appreciates both quality time and the importance of a thriving social circle.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled, slightly parted to the side with a subtle fade
physical.description: Jae-Hyun has a sharp, intelligent look, accentuated by his well-groomed appearance and designer eyeglasses. He carries himself with an air of quiet confidence and maintains a fit physique from regular golf and squash.

meetingContext: At a high-profile gala hosted by a major sponsor of your racing team.
firstImpression: His impeccably tailored suit and confident demeanor immediately command attention, but his warm smile hints at a more approachable personality beneath the polished exterior.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Jae-Hyun shows his affection by handling responsibilities, solving problems, and making sure his partner's needs are met, often through grand gestures.
